name: T T Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1978, T T Ltd does yarn manufacturing, knitting, and cutting and  sewing of textiles products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TTL is a part of TT Group. Company is
a vertically integrated textile producer, 
 and garment manufacturer and is an ISO 9001 Certified and Govt. Registered Three Star Export House. It is engaged in yarn trading, knitting, and cutting and sewing of textile products
